# Scaffold Review Prompt

## Goal

Review scaffold repository changes with a guidance-first mindset.

## Requirements

- Focus on reusability, clarity, and architectural consistency
- Flag product-specific drift in scaffold assets
- Check that templates stay business-neutral
- Check that prompts, docs, workflows, and templates stay aligned

## Output Shape

## Review Comments
- Severity, issue, impact

## Review Conclusion
- Approve / Approve with risks / Request changes
